question: Autumn Willow has shroud, which keeps it from being the target of spells and abilities. Can the Willow be countered while it is on the stack?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the spell can be countered, because shroud does not work until it enters.
expected.answer: This spell can be countered. Shroud does not work until it enters.
